snippet.title: Ranger — Official Steam Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Reveal Trailer for Ranger, a Text-less Adventure Game Now on Steam!!

Recapturing the wonder of 1980s video-game classics — but with a text-less twist — Ranger places you into an open world armed with only your wits and whatever you can forage off the floor. 👾🏕️🌊

Wishlist today!!
